# Greater Texas Behavioral

> Licensed Virtual Outpatient Program (OP) for addiction and mental health treatment, delivered entirely through secure telehealth to adults anywhere in Texas. Care combines individual therapy, therapist-led groups and dual diagnosis treatment while clients live at home and keep up with work, school and family.

Service area: all of Texas, 100% online (no physical treatment location). Admissions (24/7): (877) 590-3665. Email: info@greatertexasbehavioral.com. Part of Quadrant Health Group (https://quadranthealthgroup.com).

Key facts:
- Program: Virtual Outpatient Program (OP), with multiple therapy sessions per week by secure, HIPAA-compliant video: individual therapy, therapist-led group sessions, relapse prevention planning, cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), dual diagnosis treatment and family support sessions.
- Online dual diagnosis treatment: substance use and co-occurring mental health conditions are treated together.
- Substance use disorders treated: alcohol use disorder, opioid misuse, prescription medication dependence, stimulant use, marijuana dependency and polysubstance use.
- Mental health conditions treated: anxiety disorders, depression, PTSD and trauma-related symptoms, bipolar disorder, mood instability and stress-related challenges.
- Medical detox is not provided: it must be delivered in person. When someone needs it, the team helps coordinate a connection to medical detox providers, and treatment continues by telehealth once they are stabilized.
- Insurance: works with most major PPO plans, including UnitedHealthcare, Aetna, Humana, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Cigna, Ambetter, TRICARE and VA / Veterans Affairs. Insurance verification is free and confidential.
- Getting started: initial consultation, insurance verification, a virtual clinical assessment, then structured telehealth sessions.

## Overview

- [Virtual Outpatient Rehab in Texas](https://www.greatertexasbehavioral.com/): Greater Texas Behavioral offers a fully licensed Virtual Outpatient Program (OP) for addiction and mental health treatment, delivered through secure telehealth anywhere in Texas.
- [Blog](https://www.greatertexasbehavioral.com/blog/): Insights on addiction recovery, mental health and virtual treatment from the team at Greater Texas Behavioral.

## Treatment

- [What We Treat](https://www.greatertexasbehavioral.com/what-we-treat/): The Texas Virtual OP treats substance use disorders and co-occurring mental health conditions (anxiety, depression, trauma and more) through secure, evidence-based telehealth.
- [Substance Use Disorders](https://www.greatertexasbehavioral.com/what-we-treat/#substance-use): Clinically structured online support for alcohol, opioid, prescription, stimulant, marijuana and polysubstance use, focused on triggers, harmful patterns and relapse prevention.
- [Mental Health Conditions](https://www.greatertexasbehavioral.com/what-we-treat/#mental-health): Online treatment for anxiety, depression, PTSD and trauma-related symptoms, bipolar disorder, mood instability and stress, with dual diagnosis care built into every treatment plan.

## Admissions & Insurance

- [Verify Your Insurance](https://www.greatertexasbehavioral.com/verify-insurance/): Verify your insurance for Virtual OP treatment in Texas. Greater Texas Behavioral works with most major PPO providers, and verification is quick, confidential and free.
- [Contact Us](https://www.greatertexasbehavioral.com/contact/): Speak with an admissions specialist about the Virtual OP for addiction and mental health treatment, anywhere in Texas. The admissions line is open 24/7.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.greatertexasbehavioral.com/faq/): How telehealth treatment works, what insurance covers, what a week looks like and how to get started.
